title: habenaria rotundifolia
intro: Habenaria rotundifolia, commonly known as the Round-leaved Habenaria, is a species of orchid native to tropical Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Habenaria rotundifolia include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Habenaria rotundifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
